settings.label: Boost player contrast
settings.why: Makes player models stand out against the map.

settings.label: Global shadow quality
settings.why: Kept high on purpose: an enemy's shadow can show before the enemy does.

settings.label: Shader detail
settings.why: Lighting polish you don't need to spot anyone.

settings.label: Particle detail
settings.why: Less smoke, fire, and spark clutter in fights.

settings.label: Ambient occlusion
settings.why: Soft contact shadows that cost frames and show you nothing.

settings.label: V-Sync
settings.why: V-Sync holds frames back, which adds input lag.

settings.label: NVIDIA Reflex
settings.why: Cuts the delay between your click and the shot on NVIDIA cards. Other cards ignore it.
